title: Buenos Aires · Sierra de la Ventana Weekend
slogan: A 1244 km loop out of Azul fuel
story: A real weekend escape from the flat city grid. 1208 km round from Azul - plan on about 20 h 50 of riding. The stops in between: Sierra de la Ventana, Cerro Ventana view and Tornquist hills. It keeps to quiet secondary roads. The plan has 1 fuel stop marked.

sections.advice: Use Buenos Aires start → Azul fuel as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: This Sierra de la Ventana → Cerro Ventana view stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
